pages.text: The $(l:armors/sinner_robes)$(c)$(o)Sinner's Robe$() Leggings' Ability slot is a bit special. It can be used as a Pocket to hold a storage-related, such as a Bundles, a Shulker Box or an Ender Chest. Additionally, it does still have its own Abilities though, which are primarily storage focused: This very collection of Research Notes can be comfortably slotted in for an easy method of carry.
